items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: When was it you played with Paris? ... Yeah. Oh, after that. After that. Yeah. I didn't play with them long

ctx.x: The End The End Okay, I'm going to get the date. 31st of January 1962, Eddie Dawson, Type 1. Can you tell us your birth date, Eddie? When were you born? 19...let me see...24th of July. 24th of July. What year would that be? That was...1884. Uh huh. And did any of your family play instruments before you? No, no. Did you pick it up? Just picked it up myself. How old were you when you first started playing? About 18. You bought yourself a bass, did you, or did you make one up, Paul? Uh huh. You bought a bass from a…

So I'll tell you why, they fired Billy Moran for me. Took me in the band, they had a falling out. Which band was that? That was that band they had to call it the... I don't see that band. Whose band was it? Who was the leader? Yeah. Wait now. Billy Moran and let me see who's the leader now. How you call him? He's a trumpet player. Good trumpet player too. Perez was it? Manny Perez. Manny Perez. Manny Perez. Who else was in that band? Do you remember that Eddie? Oh man, that's been Manny Perez, Billy Moran and…
